one_time_products.title: Remove Ads
one_time_products.description: Permanently removes all banner and interstitial ads. Rewarded videos stay optional, so you can still earn coins, boosters and +5 bubble continues.

one_time_products.title: 100 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 100 coins to your wallet. Spend coins on Bombs, Rainbows, Fireballs, lives and the Midnight theme.

one_time_products.title: 400 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 400 coins to your wallet. Spend coins on Bombs, Rainbows, Fireballs, lives and the Midnight theme.

one_time_products.title: 800 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 800 coins to your wallet. Great value pack: spend coins on Bombs, Rainbows, Fireballs, lives and themes.

one_time_products.title: 2000 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 2000 coins to your wallet. Our largest pack and the most coins per dollar: spend on Bombs, Rainbows, Fireballs and themes.

one_time_products.title: 5 Lives
one_time_products.description: Instantly refills your lives. In Bubble Shooter a life is a continue: run out of bubbles, spend a life and get 5 more on the same board.

one_time_products.title: 1hr Unlimited
one_time_products.description: One hour of unlimited lives: whenever you run out of bubbles, take 5 more on the same board without spending a life.

one_time_products.title: Unlimited Lives
one_time_products.description: Never run out of lives. Every time you run out of bubbles you can take 5 more on the same board, forever.

one_time_products.title: Fireball Pack
one_time_products.description: Adds 10 Fireballs. A Fireball flies straight through every bubble in its path, bouncing off the walls, and frees any Pip it touches.

one_time_products.title: Starter Pack
one_time_products.description: 100 coins + 5 Fireballs + 5 lives + Ads Off, bundled for new players. One-time purchase.

subscriptions.title: Season Pass
subscriptions.description: Monthly pass: ad-free play, +100 coins every day, all themes unlocked, and unlimited Fireballs. Cancel anytime in Google Play.

subscriptions.title: Weekly Pass
subscriptions.description: Weekly pass: ad-free play, +50 coins every day, all themes unlocked, and unlimited Fireballs. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
